event.description:
Measuring conversational AI: how can we get reliable results when answers vary?

LINK: https://youtube.com/live/znn_VKfQh8o?feature=share

Ask ChatGPT the same question twice, and you may get different answers. So how can we measure what an AI says and draw reliable conclusions?
This is the challenge Bubbling tackles by analysing how brands appear in responses from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity. The main difficulty: building a reliable measurement system at scale, using models whose answers vary and evolve over time.
Drawing on their experience in production, Emmanuel Dollé and Ludovic Cravoisier will explore the technical challenges behind this problem:

Sampling: how many responses do you need to analyse to get representative results?
Confidence intervals: how can you quantify the uncertainty around a measurement?
Model drift: how can you track changes in responses over time?
A talk to understand how to turn variable answers into useful measurements, and what gets more complex as you scale.

[GOOGLE CALENDAR LINK](https://calendar.google.com/calendar/render?action=TEMPLATE&text=%5B42+CENTRAL%5D+Online+Meeting+with+Bubbling%2C+An+AI+Startup&dates=20261007T120000Z%2F20261007T133000Z&details=Measuring+conversational+AI%3A+how+can+we+get+reliable+results+when+answers+vary%3F%0D%0A%0D%0ALINK%3A+https%3A%2F%2Fyoutube.com%2Flive%2Fznn_VKfQh8o%3Ffeature%3Dshare%0D%0A%0D%0AAsk+ChatGPT+the+same+question+twice%2C+and+you+may+get+different+answers.+So+how+can+we+measure+what+an+AI+says+and+draw+reliable+conclusions%3F%0D%0AThis+is+the+challenge+Bubbling+tackles+by+analysing+how+brands+appear+in+responses+from+ChatGPT%2C+Claude%2C+Gemini+and+Perplexity.+The+main+difficulty%3A+building+a+reliable+measurement+system+at+scale%2C+using+models+whose+answers+vary+and+evolve+over+time.%0D%0ADrawing+on+their+experience+in+production%2C+Emmanuel+Doll%C3%A9+and+Ludovic+Cravoisier+will+explore+the+technical+challenges+behind+this+problem%3A%0D%0A%0D%0ASampling%3A+how+many+responses+do+you+need+to+analyse+to+get+representative+results%3F%0D%0AConfidence+intervals%3A+how+can+you+quantify+the+uncertainty+around+a+measurement%3F%0D%0AModel+drift%3A+how+can+you+track+changes+in+responses+over+time%3F%0D%0AA+talk+to+understand+how+to+turn+variable+answers+into+useful+measurements%2C+and+what+gets+more+complex+as+you+scale.&location=)

event.description:
¡Llega la gran final del **HACKTHON 42442**!

Después de varios días de desarrollo, los equipos presentarán sus proyectos ante un jurado y mostrarán las soluciones que han creado para mejorar la comunidad de **42 Madrid**, utilizando la **API de 42**.

Una oportunidad para descubrir sus propuestas, compartir aprendizajes, recibir feedback y celebrar el trabajo colectivo.

Cerraremos con el **veredicto del jurado, la entrega de premios y un espacio de networking** para toda la comunidad.

- **16:00–16:10 | Bienvenida:** presentación de la dinámica de THE VERDICT.
- **16:10–17:00 | Presentación de proyectos:** los equipos defenderán sus soluciones ante el jurado.
- **17:00–17:30 | Mesa redonda:** experiencias, retos y aprendizajes de los participantes. En paralelo, deliberación del jurado y cierre de la peer-evaluation.
- **17:30–18:00 | THE VERDICT:** anuncio de los proyectos ganadores y entrega de premios.
- **A partir de las 18:00 | Networking** y cierre del HACKTHON 42442.
